{{RV|type=command

|game1= argo
|version1= 1.00

|serverExec= server

|gr1= Argo

|descr= Start the provided mission (if it exists) on a dedicated server.

|mp= Only works on a '''dedicated''' server.

|s1= [[serverStartMission]] missionName

|p1= missionName: [[String]] - mission name with terrain extension

|r1= [[Boolean]] - [[true]] if the mission could be started on a dedicated server, [[false]] otherwise

|x1= <sqf>
if (!isServer) exitWith {};

if (isDedicated) then
{
	serverStartMission "TestMission.Malden";
}
else // hasInterface
{
	hint "You must choose a mission now.";
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[playMission]] [[playScriptedMission]]
}}
